_doc: Layer of every CmuxNext target (plans/cmux-next/architecture-refactor-DESIGN.md section 2). layer = what the target holds today (a target that mixes layers takes its highest one and lists the others in mixes). Read by scripts/cmux-next/arch-layers.py (the report) and the pre-push layer gate scripts/cmux-next/arch_rules/layer_gate.py, which refuses a push that adds a Package.swift target missing here or an edge that breaks the order, and by the arch ratchet's layer rows (scripts/cmux-next/arch_counts.py: hard, soft, upward, unplaced). Edges may only point to the same or a lower layer; core < service < domain < ui < app. Every target entry is an object with a string `layer`; an entry without one leaves the target unplaced.

CmuxNextDaemonService.plan: drop AgentPane, Apps, Bridge, Layout: lift the shared types to Core or a protocol seam

CmuxNextStash.plan: History model moves to a domain package without views

CmuxNextHomeEngine.plan: views (4 NSView) to CmuxNextHome; engine drops Design, Icons, AgentPane

CmuxNextSettings.plan: drop Design: its 86 value types move to CmuxNextDesignTokens

CmuxNextBridge.plan: maps daemon state to view models: the models it fills move out of Layout, Sidebar, Tabs into their domain packages

CmuxNextNowPlaying.plan: drop Sidebar, Browser, AgentPane: protocol seams

CmuxNextDevices.plan: the hub client, socket, identity and relay sealing are service; DeviceHub (@MainActor @Observable) is the domain model

CmuxNextAgentLanes.plan: lane feed (domain) apart from the Priority view

CmuxNextDesign.plan: split: DesignTokens (core values, Tunables), Appearance (DesignSettings, ThemeStore: domain), Design (UI kit)

CmuxNextSidebar.plan: Model/Store/Logic to a domain package (owner a590)

CmuxNextBrowser.plan: split: BrowserCore (engine protocols, values), BrowserCEF and BrowserWebKit (engines), Browser (UI)

CmuxNextDesignTokens.plan: values only; DesignSettings and ThemeStore go to CmuxNextAppearance (B3)

_exceptions_doc: Soft edges (service -> domain) the pre-push layer gate (scripts/cmux-next/arch_rules/layer_gate.py) lets in: {"from": target, "to": target, "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "reason": why, and the slice that removes it}. Hard edges (to ui or app) and upward edges (core -> service, core -> domain) have no exceptions. The 12 soft edges already on feat-cmux-next are debt, not exceptions: they are listed by arch-layers.py and removed with the Settings split (DESIGN section 2). The arch ratchet's count rule counts the layer_soft total separately: the push that adds an entry here also adds {"date", "row": "layer_soft", "allow": 1, "why"} to plans/cmux-next/arch-ratchet.json `exceptions`.
_relayered_doc: Relabels: a push that changes the layer of a target already in `targets` adds one entry here, {"target": name, "from": old layer, "to": new layer, "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "reason": what changed in the target's code that moves it}, and the same push changes that code (a file under the target's sources); otherwise the pre-push layer gate refuses it and names the edges whose class it changes. The gate always classifies a new edge with the stricter of the two layers, so a relabel lands in its own push before any new edge that needs it. A relabel that only clears a hard or soft edge is that debt renamed: fix the edge instead. Only CmuxNextApp is app.
